subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should Feishu expose `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` as a permanent channel and per-account configuration contract, or should proactive pacing be internally managed without a new operator setting?
rationale: Repository policy sets a high bar for new config surfaces, and tests cannot determine whether operators should tune this behavior or whether the plugin should own an automatic policy alongside existing retries.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in contract
options.body: Accept the channel and account settings after live Feishu proof, complete docs, generated metadata, and focused fresh-install/default behavior validation.

options.title: Use automatic pacing
options.body: Remove the new public setting and implement an owner-chosen adaptive policy based on documented per-chat limits and retry feedback.

options.title: Keep retry-only behavior
options.body: Close this direction and rely on the existing bounded retry path unless new production evidence shows retries are insufficient.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Accept the channel and account settings after live Feishu proof, complete docs, generated metadata, and focused fresh-install/default behavior validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata and PR routing identify this person as the best available Feishu plugin contact for deciding the public configuration contract.
